excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]已被提升至[GetLeaderStatusAdjCap]地位，因在[ship.GetName]最近于[system.GetName]恒星系的交战期间观测到其高度的响应能力。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] was elevated to [GetLeaderStatusAdjCap] status following observations of their heightened responses during the [ship.GetName]'s recent engagement in the [system.GetName] system.

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]已被提升至[GetLeaderStatusAdjCap]地位，因在[ship.GetName]最近于[system.GetName]恒星系的交战期间观测到其高度的响应能力。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] was elevated to [GetLeaderStatusAdjCap] status following observations of their heightened responses during the [ship.GetName]'s recent engagement in the [system.GetName] system.

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]已在指挥系统中被提拔，因其成功地处理了[ship.GetName]在[system.GetName]星系内战斗时不断增加的处理负荷。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] has been moved up the chain of command as a result of its successful handling of increased processing load during the [ship.GetName]'s battle in the [system.GetName] system.

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]舰长，即[ship.GetName]的指挥军官，最近在[system.GetName]星系的战斗中表现杰出。[Root.Capital.GetName]的海军司令部决定嘉奖这位非常有潜力的舰长，将其晋升为指挥官。
texts.en: Captain [officer.GetName], the commanding officer of the [ship.GetName], served with distinction during the recent engagement that took place in the [system.GetName] system. The Admiralty on [Root.Capital.GetName], recognizing the qualities of a promising flag officer, has decided to promote the Captain to the rank of full commander.

tooltips.zh: 一名新的指挥官加入了我们的行列。
tooltips.en: A new Commander joins our ranks.
